name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-3.5

coprocessor.notes: The ESP32-C6 companion radio is unpopulated/disabled for the air-gapped QR vault; no Wi-Fi or BLE path may participate in signing approval or request transport.

touch.notes: Touch may be used for page navigation experiments, not final approve/reject signing consent.

display.notes: The 3.5 inch 320x480 display is the reason this ESP32-P4 board is the reference ESP32 QR vault target for local Nostr event review.

camera.pinout_status: confirm MIPI-CSI camera pinout on physical hardware before driver acceptance
camera.notes: Native MIPI-CSI camera for QR scan; the ESP32-P4 has a native MIPI camera interface (decision spec 3).

approval_inputs.name: approve
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a physical control or explicitly reviewed hardware approval model after the air-gap review; touch-only approval remains disallowed.

approval_inputs.name: reject
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a different physical control or explicitly reviewed hardware rejection model after the air-gap review.

wireless_policy: Wireless must be disabled or excluded in high-assurance QR vault builds; the ESP32-C6 companion radio is unpopulated/disabled for the air gap, so no Wi-Fi or BLE path may participate in signing approval.
debug_policy: Debug access stays enabled for board bring-up and must be locked before any production-key experiment.
production_signing: disabled until the ESP32-P4 MIPI-DSI/CSI drivers, display, camera, physical controls, storage, provisioning, and signing tests pass
reference_notes: esp32_qr_vault reference board: ESP32-P4 (400 MHz dual RISC-V), radio-less air gap with the ESP32-C6 radio disabled, native MIPI camera for QR scan (decision spec 2/3).
Design lineage aligned with Kern's ESP32-P4 vault work and libwally-based BIP derivation.
Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-4B (Kern's board) is a compatible secondary - no profile is added until requested (decision spec 3).
Verify exact flash/PSRAM, ST7796 bus, FT6336 touch, and OV5647 camera pinout against the Waveshare wiki before driver acceptance.
